items.t: Western Union Yields Nearly 15%. These 3 High-Yield Stocks Haven’t Raised Their Dividends in Years
items.sum: When a dividend refuses to budge for years, the payout may be hiding a problem. Three big-yield stocks have frozen their checks, and one already swung the axe. Which warning signs separate a patient income stock from a trap?
The long-time remittance provider walked away from a $500 million merger deal due to “buyer’s remorse,” Intermex alleged in a Tuesday lawsuit.

items.t: Western Union Yields 15.5%, but Its Dividend Hasn’t Grown in 5 Years
items.sum: Western Union just paused its buybacks and walked away from a major merger, yet the payout stayed untouched. Cash flow is thinning and rivals are sprinting ahead, so how long can management keep protecting that dividend?

items.t: How Hy Vee Renewal At Western Union Stock Has Changed Its Investment Story
items.sum: Western Union announced that it renewed its long running agreement with Hy-Vee, remaining the exclusive provider of Money Transfer, Money Order and Bill Pay services across more than 270 Midwest grocery locations.
